answer: Through the vine, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Emission follows proven work: each epoch's payout scales with the identity's attested history, so a brand-new key earns near zero. The cipher makes the sybil math fail slowly and surely — clones age into value only if they do real work, and real work is exactly what a farm cannot fake cheaply. That is the point of the falcon: cloning stops paying the moment each copy costs as much as the original.
